prompts.blink:
Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept. Production PIXEL ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET of the user's selected ORIGINAL mascot MORU for Ontology Atlas.
Input image is OUR OWN selected identity reference. Preserve the QUIET COMPANION full-body seal exactly: low rounded warm stone-gray body, warm ivory cheek and belly, dark navy small diamond nose, two simple black eyes, two short whisker strokes each cheek, two indigo front flippers, curled forked indigo tail at the left, tiny ivory square notch on left tail lobe. Non-human seal, no ears, clothes, props, other characters or borrowed famous brand elements.
OUTPUT IS AN ANIMATION SOURCE SHEET, not a presentation board. EXACTLY SIX separate full-body sprites arranged in a perfectly regular THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS grid, reading left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Canvas EXACTLY1536x1024, each cell512x512. Genuine transparent background outside each sprite. NO grid lines, borders, labels, text, captions, shadows, glow, floating particles or checkerboard pattern.
Each cell represents one frame of the SAME animation. Use the SAME base drawing, body contour, size, palette, face registration, outline thickness and pixel pitch in ALL SIX CELLS. Do not draw six differently proportioned seals. The fixed full-body visual bounds occupy about448x320 pixels (native56x40 logical pixels), centered at x256, baseline y448 inside EACH cell, clear margins on all sides. Tail is behind left, body/front face on right, same facing in all cells. Motions are very small, delicate and readable, 1-3 logical pixels except the specified moving flipper/tail. Body anchor and front flipper ground contact are fixed.
Authentic coherent64x64 logical pixel cell drawing enlarged8x with integer hard square edges. 8-10 colors maximum: navy #17192D, indigo #6D73D2, muted indigo #50569C, slate-gray #AAA9A5, warm body-gray #D6D3C9, ivory #FFF1D7, dark eyes #171923. Flat color clusters with beautiful restrained shading, no gradient, antialiasing, smooth vector curves, furry texture, noisy dither or scattered pixel noise. Preserve the adorable selected simple seal, not realism or anime. Full body visible in every cell. Camera identical and orthographic side/front three-quarter throughout. All artwork must stay inside its cell.

Frame1 neutral eyes open, calm.
Frame2 same base with eyes half closed.
Frame3 same base eyes closed as two tiny peaceful horizontal pixel strokes.
Frame4 hold the closed eyes exactly, cheeks rise just1 logical pixel.
Frame5 half-open eyes.
Frame6 exactly matches Frame1 open-eyes neutral.
Only eye and at most1 cheek pixel changes; body, nose, whiskers, flippers and tail are otherwise IDENTICAL. No smile added, no wink, both eyes blink together. It should feel like a tiny living companion taking a relaxed blink, perfectly loopable.

prompts.compass:
Use case: precise-object-edit / logo-brand.
REFINE the attached OWN ORIGINAL Atlas compass app icon selected by the user. Input is the selected reference, not a third-party brand. Preserve its identity and concept: near-black rounded-square plate, broken ivory circular horizon, single diagonal two-tone compass needle pointing upper-right, ivory forward half and periwinkle rear half. NO mascot. Make ONE polished final icon, not new directions.
Brand meaning: Ontology Atlas helps Forward Deployed Engineers understand an unfamiliar system's real context, follow source evidence, and orient the next implementation decision. The compass expresses clear direction from shared understanding. No FDE lettering or technical symbols should be drawn.
Precise refinements:
- Reduce the needle's overall length by12% from reference so both tips have comfortable breathing room.
- Increase the needle's central width by15% so it is bold and recognizable in a small dock icon.
- REMOVE the little square hub/extra patch from the middle entirely. Only TWO simple flat triangular needle halves meet with a clean diagonal join.
- Make the ivory horizon circle truly circular with one uniform bold stroke. Keep the TWO purposeful gaps aligned with the needle axis (upper-right and lower-left), both gaps equal and generously open.
- Needle passes through the ring gaps without touching ring ends. Maintain equal clearances, at least one ring stroke width.
- Ring ends have precise flat radial cuts, no tiny decorations, markings, letters, tick marks, compass degree scale, border, dots, bevels, gloss, metallic effects, glow, shadows, gradients or3D.
- Balance circle and needle optically at center. Glyph occupies65-70% of plate; generous safety margins.
- Ivory #FFF1D7, periwinkle #7277D8, near-black #171923. Perfectly flat color regions. Crisp smooth geometric vector-quality silhouettes, carefully engineered proportions, no fuzzy raster texture.
Target1024x1024. OUTPUT ONLY THE LARGE APP ICON, centered, nearly fills canvas with a24px transparent outer margin. Smooth rounded-square near-black platform plate with balanced22% corner radius; actual transparency outside its mask. NO concept-board typography, labels, secondary miniatures, mock devices, layouts, background scene, wordmark or watermark.
The result should feel like the more legible and distinctive evolution of our selected original icon, calm and precise enough for a serious local-first developer workbench. Do not imitate any existing company compass logo.
